sources.paper: On the Guidance of Flow Matching
sources.source_discovery: public GitHub recursive tree API; main branch paths, not immutable snapshot
findings: guide_fn distinguishes energy gradient at current state, energy gradient at estimated endpoint, and derivative through endpoint prediction to current state
estimated endpoint is xt+(1-t)*v; derivative through predictor recomputes the model and differs from endpoint gradient
PiGDM applies a model VJP; PiGDM+ drops that VJP; inverse solves are image-operator specific
MC branch uses terminal support, path weights and normalized energy weights, not simple best-of-K reprojection selection
guidance scale and time schedule are explicit hyperparameters
sources.transfer: Do not equate these gradients, reuse image operator inverses for SMPLH/fisheye, or report MC guide as existing A6 decision.
sources.execution: source inspection only; no author code imported or run
failures: web tree URL restricted; succeeded via public GitHub API and raw source requests

sources.paper: Fast and Faithful: Principled Conditional Flow Matching for Inverse Problems
sources.read: Appendix B.1-B.3 equations69-80 and Algorithm3, Appendix D network/solver
findings: linear Gaussian normal-equation solve followed by shared learned estimator and damping
each velocity evaluation uses K data-consistency solves and K estimator calls, default K=5
parameter sharing reduces unique parameters but not number of network evaluations
exact posterior-mean theorem does not certify arbitrary finite learned HQS iterate
sources.transfer: retain shared-weight operator-aware design as research lead, stop direct linear-HQS transplantation and unqualified speed/posterior claims
sources.author_code: not acquired or verified in this pass; paper algorithm only
